paragraph: In November 1965, darkness spread across the northeastern United States and parts of Canada. Thirty million people lost power, and Lynn Lowin was one of them. For six hours, she watched strangers help each other through the blackout. Now, sixty-one years later, she wanted younger people to hear her story. She reached out to Good News Network, a site that shares uplifting stories, so others could learn what she saw.
